On November 10, 2026 (the "Grant Date"), the reporting person was granted 200,000 restricted stock units ("RSUs") pursuant to the terms and conditions of a restricted stock unit award agreement and the issuer's amended and restated 2023 incentive compensation plan. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of the issuer's common stock upon vesting and settlement. 20% of the RSUs vested on the Grant Date, and the remaining 80% vest in 12 equal quarterly installments on the last day of each calendar quarter, commencing December 31, 2026 and ending September 30, 2029, provided that the reporting person is serving as an employee of the issuer on each applicable vesting date.
